name: filters other hosts and normalizes fragments
input: same-host graph with repeated fragment variants
test:
import asyncio
class Web:
    def __init__(self):
        self.pages = {
            'http://docs.test/': ['http://docs.test/a#one', 'http://docs.test/a#two', 'http://docs.test/b', 'http://other.test/skip'],
            'http://docs.test/a': ['http://docs.test/c?x=1#part'],
            'http://docs.test/b': [],
            'http://docs.test/c?x=1': []
        }
        self.calls = []
    async def get_urls(self, url):
        self.calls.append(url)
        return self.pages[url]
web = Web()
result = asyncio.run(crawl('http://docs.test/#home', web, workers=2))
assert result == {'http://docs.test/', 'http://docs.test/a', 'http://docs.test/b', 'http://docs.test/c?x=1'}
assert sorted(web.calls) == ['http://docs.test/', 'http://docs.test/a', 'http://docs.test/b', 'http://docs.test/c?x=1']

name: cycles do not cause duplicate fetches
input: three pages linked in a cycle
test:
import asyncio
class Web:
    def __init__(self):
        self.pages = {
            'http://site.test/': ['http://site.test/a'],
            'http://site.test/a': ['http://site.test/b'],
            'http://site.test/b': ['http://site.test/', 'http://site.test/a']
        }
        self.calls = []
    async def get_urls(self, url):
        self.calls.append(url)
        return self.pages[url]
web = Web()
assert asyncio.run(crawl('http://site.test/', web)) == set(web.pages)
assert len(web.calls) == len(set(web.calls)) == 3

name: independent pages can use the bounded worker pool concurrently
input: root with two slow children and two workers
test:
import asyncio
class Web:
    def __init__(self):
        self.pages = {
            'http://parallel.test/': ['http://parallel.test/a', 'http://parallel.test/b'],
            'http://parallel.test/a': [],
            'http://parallel.test/b': []
        }
        self.active = 0
        self.peak = 0
    async def get_urls(self, url):
        self.active += 1
        self.peak = max(self.peak, self.active)
        await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
        self.active -= 1
        return self.pages[url]
web = Web()
assert asyncio.run(crawl('http://parallel.test/', web, workers=2)) == set(web.pages)
assert web.peak == 2
